content.title: 6 displaced after Prince George’s County home catches fire - AOL
content.text: Kaitlyn DillonSat, April 11, 2026 at 6:16 PM CDT0PRINCE GEORGE’S COUNTY, Md. (DC News Now) — Six people were displaced after a Saturday house fire in Prince George’s County.According to the Prince George’s County Fire and EMS Department, crews responded to reports of a house fire at 4:39 p.m. in the 1200 block of Benning Rd in Coral Hills. 7 displaced after Takoma Park apartment fire There, a small fire was located in the first-floor bathroom of the three-story home and was quickly extinguished.Firefighters said no injuries were reported, and the displaced residents are receiving assistance from the Prince George’s County Office of Emergency Management.The cause of the fire remains under investigation.Copyright 2026 Nexstar Media, Inc.
